# IEA-PVPS — Malaysia 2025 Country Update
URL: https://iea-pvps.org/about-iea-pvps/members/malaysia/
Date captured: 2026-08-11

## National PV Policy
Frameworks: National Energy Policy 2022–2040, MyRER, NETR. NETR target 70% RE capacity + carbon neutrality by 2050; solar PV key driver. By end 2025, 31% interim capacity (hydro + PV).
Schemes: FiT, NEM, LSS, SELCO. EC oversees LSS/SELCO; SEDA manages FiT/NEM. Sarawak separate ordinance; Sabah regulated by ECoS.

## NEM -> Solar ATAP
NEM introduced 2016, concluded Jun 2025, >2,600 MW quota awarded. Replaced by Solar ATAP from Jan 2026: no quota, continuous, higher caps (single phase <=5kWac; three phase <=15kWac domestic; non-domestic <=100% max demand capped 1,000kW). Domestic offset at regulated retail tariff; non-domestic credited at SMP.

## SELCO
Self-consumption, no export. 2025 revised: removed 85% capacity limit for non-domestic (now up to 100% demand); added ground-mounted/floating; mandatory BESS for >72kWp deferred to 31 Dec 2025; standby charge only >1MWp (~RM12/kWp/month); extended to agriculture.

## Virtual purchase schemes
- CGPP, CRESS (2024), CREAM. CRESS: direct RE supply to corporate via grid; expanded 1 Mar 2025 to all existing MV/HV TNB customers; SAC 25¢/kWh firm w/ BESS, 45¢ non-firm.
- CREAM: residential rooftops aggregated, lease to developers, supply within 5km; CAC 15¢/kWh cut 40% -> 9¢/kWh. Flagship City of Elmina (Sime Darby) targets 6,000 rooftops.

## Financial
GTFS 4.0 RM1bn to Dec 2025 (6 sectors incl. energy). NETF blended finance; MDV approved ~RM122.65m + ~RM40.09m incentives. KWTBB 1.6% charge waived for GET/CRESS/CREAM.

## Industry & Market Development
PV industry transformed by global trade: US anti-dumping/CVD duties on SEA solar (incl. Malaysia) raised export costs; First Solar, Jinko, Risen, JA Solar, LONGi scaled back/ceased MY manufacturing. Oversupply from China keeps module prices low (price war). China cut VAT export rebate 13%->9% Dec 2024 -> upward price pressure, muted in 2025, higher prices expected 2026 after full rebate removal.
Tariffs revised upward Q3 2025 (fuel costs, grid investment); ~85% domestic unaffected, industrial challenged. Measures: Energy Efficiency Incentive, TOU, targeted subsidies, AFA replacing ICPT.

## Grid / Storage
BESS critical for variability. MyBEST: 400MW/1,600MWh, commissioned 2027. Sabah first large-scale BESS Lahad Datu 100MW/400MWh. ASEAN Power Grid for regional interconnection.

## Capacity stats (end 2025)
- Total PV (LSS+FiT+NEM): 5,777.73 MW.
- LSS cumulative 2,237 MW; 60 MW commissioned 2025 (DTU1/DTU2 floating, Kelantan).
- FiT cumulative 1,225.29 MWac (618.84 operational); solar PV largest active 345.41 MW.
- NEM cumulative 3,000 MWac quota; 87.71% subscribed (2,747.92 MW).
